title: freeBoundary
summary: Return boundary edges for a DelaunayTri triangulation.

gpu_support.notes: `freeBoundary` operates on DelaunayTri object topology on the host.

description: `freeBoundary(dt)` returns an M-by-2 one-based edge list for edges used by only one triangle in a 2-D `DelaunayTri` object.
behaviors: Accepts `DelaunayTri` objects from the legacy constructor.
Returns one-based vertex indices sorted deterministically by edge.
Returns a 0-by-2 tensor for empty triangulations.
